name: 06-method-not-allowed
description: PATCH is not declared for /munit in the RAML, so APIkit raises MethodNotAllowedException, mapped to 405 with a JSON message.

source.reference: testing-apikit-with-munit/src/main/app/api.xml (apikit:mapping statusCode=405 MethodNotAllowedException -> payload { "message": "Method not allowed" }); testing-apikit-with-munit/src/main/api/api.raml (/munit declares get, post, put, delete only)
